newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index drops by 4.48 points.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index drops by 4.48 points.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange on Tuesday closed down by 4.48 points in higher trade on the bond's market, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 592.86 from 597.34 on Monday.
Trade volume was 1.22 million dinars against 207,499 dinars. Exchanges on the first market were thin, and more than half of the trade volume was on the bond's market.
BIAT bank was down 1.9 dinar to 61.3 dinars. AMEN bank eased 1.67 dinar to 53.95 dinars. ($=0.97 dinar)
